text:
maya: Quick sync — need to lock RFC review roster for next Tue 11am PT. Authors need slots and pre-read reminder. Who's on reviewer duty and any ordering prefs? /cc @alex @kevin @sasha

alex: I can review 2 short RFCs (20m total). prefer to keep small ones first.

kevin: Available. can cover the big one if it's later in agenda. also can do pre-read by EOD Monday.

sasha: Pre-reads uploaded to the repo: https://git.example.com/rfcs/rfc-stack-orbit. I annotated the long one with an "open questions" section. please read before Tue.

maya: Thanks. Proposed agenda (30min total):
```
1) Quick intros (2m)
2) RFC A (10m) - author: @leo
3) RFC B (8m) - author: @tina
4) RFC C (8m) - author: @sam
```
Can we swap B/C order if that helps? Also need someone to take notes.

jordan: I can do notes. +1 to batching short ones first. If @leo needs >10m we can push C later.

alex: If leo wants demo, give him 15. otherwise 10 ok. Also suggest we block 5m at end for action items.

kevin: Confirmed reviewer availability. I'll review C and take followups.

maya: Cool. I'll update calendar invite and ping authors. calendar-bot: send reminder Mon 9am PT.

calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: will post pre-read ping to thread Monday 09:00 PT.

sasha: Also quick ask — can authors paste a 2-line TL;DR at top of RFC to speed reviews?

maya: Yes please. I'll nudge authors for TL;DRs. @leo @tina @sam — TL;DR + one-sentence deployment risk before Mon EOD :pray: 

leo: Got it; TL;DRs incoming today.

tina: Will do, and I'll add a tiny diagram.

sam: I may need the extra slot if demo runs long — @maya can we keep 5m buffer?

maya: We can flex. final agenda will go out Mon morning. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
